data.body: Landed: change 1338 merged as 52cd34f169 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). AC evidence: (1) both new gate steps (raw-git-write, wall-clock-assert) guarded with if-present checks — run script when in tree, log + skip when absent; (2) skew rationale + copy-me idiom documented inline at the raw-git-write step, referenced from the wall-clock step; (3) actionlint clean via make lint, both guard branches exercised locally (present -> detector runs, exit propagates; absent-in-/tmp -> skip message, exit 0), CI on 1338 itself proves the present branch end-to-end. Recovery for the originally broken changes: rebase:chain on 1332/1333 restored Verified (both since merged: de-facto proof the diagnosis was right). Prevention: future gate authors copy the guard with the step.
